# Stack Overflow

> Developer Q&A community for asking, answering, and discovering programming questions across languages, frameworks, and tools.

Stack Overflow is the flagship Stack Exchange community for software developers. It provides question feeds, tag directories, user profiles, help resources, community discussion on Meta, real-time chat, and adjacent products like AI Assist, Challenges, and company information.

## Core Q&A
- [Questions](https://stackoverflow.com/questions): Main question listing for browsing programming questions across all topics.
- [Newest Questions](https://stackoverflow.com/questions?tab=Newest): Most recently asked questions on Stack Overflow.
- [Active Questions](https://stackoverflow.com/questions?tab=Active): Questions with the latest activity, including new answers and edits.
- [Bountied Questions](https://stackoverflow.com/questions?tab=Bounties): Questions with active reputation bounties seeking more attention.
- [Unanswered Questions](https://stackoverflow.com/unanswered): Questions that do not yet have accepted or upvoted answers.
- [Ask a Question](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/ask): Form for posting a new programming question to the community.

## Discovery and Topics
- [Tags](https://stackoverflow.com/tags): Directory of programming tags used to categorize questions.
- [Tag Synonyms](https://stackoverflow.com/tags/synonyms): Canonical mappings between related or duplicate tags.
- [Tag Search](https://stackoverflow.com/tags?tab=popular): Popular tags across languages, frameworks, and developer tools.
- [Questions by Tag](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/tagged/python): Example tag feed for questions labeled with a specific topic.
- [Tag Info](https://stackoverflow.com/tags/python/info): Tag wiki and usage guidance for a specific technology.
- [Tag Trends](https://stackoverflow.com/tags?tab=name): Alphabetical tag browsing for topic discovery.

## Users and Reputation
- [Users](https://stackoverflow.com/users): Directory of Stack Overflow community members.
- [Current User Profile](https://stackoverflow.com/users/current): Shortcut to the signed-in user's profile.
- [Top Users](https://stackoverflow.com/users?tab=Reputation): Users ranked by reputation score.
- [New Users](https://stackoverflow.com/users?tab=NewUsers): Recently joined community members.
- [Moderators](https://stackoverflow.com/users?tab=Moderators): Elected moderators for the Stack Overflow community.
- [Badges](https://stackoverflow.com/help/badges): Reference for badges awarded for participation and contributions.

## Help and Community Policies
- [Help Center](https://stackoverflow.com/help): Central help documentation for using Stack Overflow effectively.
- [How to Ask](https://stackoverflow.com/help/how-to-ask): Guidance for writing clear, answerable programming questions.
- [What Topics Can I Ask About Here?](https://stackoverflow.com/help/on-topic): Scope and on-topic policy for Stack Overflow questions.
- [How to Answer](https://stackoverflow.com/help/how-to-answer): Best practices for posting useful, complete answers.
- [Privileges](https://stackoverflow.com/help/privileges): Reputation-based permissions available to community members.
- [Badges](https://stackoverflow.com/help/badges): Badge system and criteria for earning recognition.
- [Tour](https://stackoverflow.com/tour): Introductory overview of how Stack Overflow works.

## Account and Participation
- [Sign Up](https://stackoverflow.com/users/signup): Account registration for participating on Stack Overflow.
- [Log In](https://stackoverflow.com/users/login): Sign in to an existing Stack Overflow account.
- [Edit Profile](https://stackoverflow.com/users/edit/current): Update profile details, preferences, and public information.
- [Inbox](https://stackoverflow.com/inbox): Notifications for replies, comments, and community events.
- [Reputation](https://stackoverflow.com/users/current?tab=reputation): View reputation changes for the current user.
- [Preferences](https://stackoverflow.com/users/preferences/current): Manage account and site preferences.

## Community Discussion and Chat
- [Meta Stack Overflow](https://meta.stackoverflow.com): Community discussion about site policy, features, and moderation.
- [Meta Questions](https://meta.stackoverflow.com/questions): Posts about Stack Overflow governance and product changes.
- [Chat](https://chat.stackoverflow.com/?tab=explore): Real-time chat rooms for developer discussions and collaboration.
- [Chat Rooms](https://chat.stackoverflow.com/rooms): Directory of available Stack Overflow chat rooms.
- [Chat FAQ](https://chat.stackoverflow.com/faq): Help documentation for using Stack Overflow chat.
- [Stack Exchange Communities](https://stackexchange.com/sites): Directory of other communities in the Stack Exchange network.

## Products and Features
- [AI Assist](https://stackoverflow.com/ai-assist): Stack Overflow AI-assisted experience for finding and generating technical help.
- [Challenges](https://stackoverflow.com/beta/challenges): Coding and community challenge hub on Stack Overflow.
- [Companies](https://stackoverflow.com/jobs/companies): Employer and company presence on Stack Overflow.
- [Developer Jobs](https://stackoverflow.com/jobs): Job-related area for developer career opportunities and employers.
- [Teams](https://stackoverflow.co/teams/): Stack Overflow for Teams product for private knowledge sharing.
- [Advertising](https://stackoverflow.co/advertising/): Information about reaching developers through Stack Overflow advertising products.

## Content and Publishing
- [Stack Overflow Blog](https://stackoverflow.blog): Official blog covering engineering, community, and developer industry topics.
- [Articles](https://stackoverflow.blog/contributed): Community and editorial article hub linked from Stack Overflow navigation.
- [Engineering Blog Posts](https://stackoverflow.blog/category/engineering/): Technical posts about systems, tooling, and platform engineering.
- [Community Blog Posts](https://stackoverflow.blog/category/community/): Updates about moderation, community programs, and site culture.
- [Podcast Posts](https://stackoverflow.blog/category/podcast/): Podcast episodes and related editorial content.
- [Company Blog Posts](https://stackoverflow.blog/category/company/): Announcements about Stack Overflow products and business updates.
